test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can replace the bracketed word segment in the following sentence.

Children should avoid giving out personal details online (which will) identify them or their location.
solution:
The correct answer is ‘2’ i.e. that could.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **'that could'** is appropriate as it indicates the possibility or potential of identifying them or their location.
 
• Other options do not fit the context as well as **'that could'**.
 
 
• **‘whichever can’** is incorrect as it does not imply possibility effectively in this context.
 
• **‘which might lead’** changes the meaning and indicates a consequence rather than the direct action of identification.
 
• **‘what will’** is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the sentence properly.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *Children should avoid giving out personal details online that could identify them or their location.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In sentences that discuss possibilities or potential outcomes, **'could'** often fits well to express these conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** *Actions that could harm the environment should be avoided.*
